input.description: When a caller builds the packet derivation, mkGovPackageOutput serializes mkConfig JSON and shell writes config.json in build workdir. Python command 'build --config config.json --out $out'; required sourcePaths must be accessible.

output.description: On Nix build, shell writes config.json in working directory; Python CLI build(config.json,$out) constructs input source rows producerConfig (relative config.json; class=path), repoMetadata (class=derived-config), seven input roles (class=inline in this example), and repoReadme sourcePath (usually path-class); sorts input rows canonically and hashes rows JSONL to inputLockDigest. Normalizes content with trailing LF. Writes 11 generated files: 9 domain packet files manifest.json, repo.json, packages.jsonl, assertions.jsonl, receipts.jsonl, readmeProjectionReceipt.jsonl, provider-ci.jsonl, findings.jsonl, admission.jsonl PLUS input-manifest.jsonl and producer-provenance.json. outputDigest is SHA256 over lexically sorted file names + NUL + file bytes + NUL excluding producer-provenance.json; provenance stores producerRepo/rev/digest, generatedBy, inputLockDigest, outputDigest, packetDigest, nonAuthority=true. Build artifact success does not prove the original ADRS required digest fields. Python stdout result includes inputLockDigest/outputDigest only after successful build; normalized bytes are non-authority evidence.

input.description: Build after packet derivation: args only pkgs,packet, so wrapper omits sourceRoot/rev/digest. --packet, --producer-repo default, --require-pass. Rehashes canonical input manifest and output packet. Only path-class rows are reopened; inline and derived-config rows are NOT reopened. CLI --require-pass converts any findings into exit1 (otherwise a failure report may still exit0).
